items.snippet: Starting November 16, Apple will require developers to disclose whether their apps include real-world location sharing or dating features so age ratings can be assigned appropriately. Apple says the Dating and Relationships disclosure is required for apps that allow dating or relationship connections, regardless of whether that's with a real person or a virtual companion that engages in sexual or romantic content. Apps that include Dating and Relationships must have a minimum age rating of 18+, but Shared Location apps may not see a change to their minimum age rating in some regions. In Brazil, apps are required to have an A16 rating for Shared Location and A18 for Dating and Relationships.

items.snippet: “I didn’t see you put that in the diary.” Sound familiar? Shared calendars solved scheduling, not communication. OurCal connects any calendar, new or existing, to a group chat. Changes post there automatically, so nobody misses them. Because it’s a messenger, we made everything End-to-End Encrypted, certified by France’s cybersecurity agency. It’s native SwiftUI across Apple’s platforms, and the App Store just featured it in “Great apps on iPhone Duo”. We’re Apple people, but we think it’s the best shared calendar on Android too.
